title: Overview Camera Stable On Detail Radius Edits
description: Overview camera jumps when editing node radius in detail: fixture effect bumped cameraBasisTick on every patchFixture. Fix by baseline pane cameras state updated only on setFixture, redraw play start, and post-redraw ease end; fixture effect only syncs cameraBasisFixtureRef.
summary: Overview (and all panes) jumped when changing node radius in the detail inspector because every fixture patch bumped cameraBasisTick, recomputing bbox-fit cameras from triptychCamerasFromFixture for all panes. Replaced tick+useMemo with boardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline state updated only on setFixture (new graph), redraw play start, and post-redraw ease end; the fixture sync effect now only updates cameraBasisFixtureRef for layout/redraw snapshots.
